title: Bulmart
statementMd:
A new trade empire is rising in Berland. Bulmart, an emerging trade giant, decided to dominate the market of ... shovels! And now almost every city in Berland has a Bulmart store, and some cities even have several of them! The only problem is, at the moment sales are ... let's say a little below estimates. Some people even say that shovels retail market is too small for such a big company to make a profit. But the company management believes in the future of that market and seeks new ways to increase income.

There are $*n*$ cities in Berland connected with $*m*$ bi-directional roads. All roads have equal lengths. It can happen that it is impossible to reach a city from another city using only roads. There is no road which connects a city to itself. Any pair of cities can be connected by at most one road.

There are $*w*$ Bulmart stores in Berland. Each of them is described by three numbers:

- $*c*_{*i*}$ — the number of city where the $*i*$-th store is located (a city can have no stores at all or have several of them),
- $*k*_{*i*}$ — the number of shovels in the $*i*$-th store,
- $*p*_{*i*}$ — the price of a single shovel in the $*i*$-th store (in burles).

The latest idea of the Bulmart management is to create a program which will help customers get shovels as fast as possible for affordable budget. Formally, the program has to find the minimum amount of time needed to deliver $*r*_{*j*}$ shovels to the customer in the city $*g*_{*j*}$ for the total cost of no more than $*a*_{*j*}$ burles. The delivery time between any two adjacent cities is equal to $1$. If shovels are delivered from several cities, the delivery time is equal to the arrival time of the last package. The delivery itself is free of charge.

The program needs to find answers to $*q*$ such queries. Each query has to be processed independently from others, i.e. a query does not change number of shovels in stores for the next queries.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$, $*m*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5000$, $0 ≤ *m* ≤ *min*(5000, *n*·(*n* - 1) / 2))$. Each of the next $*m*$ lines contains two integers $*x*_{*e*}$ and $*y*_{*e*}$, meaning that the $*e*$-th road connects cities $*x*_{*e*}$ and $*y*_{*e*}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{*e*}, *y*_{*e*} ≤ *n*$).

The next line contains a single integer $*w*$ ($1 ≤ *w* ≤ 5000$) — the total number of Bulmart stores in Berland. Each of the next $*w*$ lines contains three integers describing the $*i*$-th store: $*c*_{*i*}, *k*_{*i*}, *p*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *k*_{*i*}, *p*_{*i*} ≤ 2·10^{5}$).

The next line contains a single integer $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *q* ≤ 1000$) — the number of queries. Each of the next $*q*$ lines contains three integers describing the $*j*$-th query: $*g*_{*j*}, *r*_{*j*}$ and $*a*_{*j*}$ ($1 ≤ *g*_{*j*} ≤ *n*$, $1 ≤ *r*_{*j*}, *a*_{*j*} ≤ 10^{9}$)

## Output

Output $*q*$ lines. On the $*j*$-th line, print an answer for the $*j*$-th query — the minimum amount of time needed to deliver $*r*_{*j*}$ shovels to the customer in city $*g*_{*j*}$ spending no more than $*a*_{*j*}$ burles. Print `-1` if there is no solution for the $*j*$-th query.
statementZhMd:
一个新的贸易帝国正在 Berland 崛起。新兴贸易巨头 Bulmart 决定主导……铲子市场！如今，Berland 几乎每座城市都有一家 Bulmart 商店，有些城市甚至有好几家！唯一的问题是，目前的销售额……只能说比预期低了一点。有些人甚至认为，铲子零售市场太小，这样一家大公司无法从中获利。但公司管理层相信这一市场的未来，并正在寻找增加收入的新方法。

Berland 有 $*n*$ 座城市，由 $*m*$ 条双向道路连接。所有道路的长度都相同。可能存在无法仅通过道路从某座城市到达另一座城市的情况。没有连接城市自身的道路。任意一对城市之间至多有一条道路。

Berland 有 $*w*$ 家 Bulmart 商店。每家商店由三个数字描述：

- $*c*_{*i*}$ — 第 $*i*$ 家商店所在的城市编号（一个城市可能没有商店，也可能有多家商店）；
- $*k*_{*i*}$ — 第 $*i*$ 家商店中的铲子数量；
- $*p*_{*i*}$ — 第 $*i*$ 家商店中单把铲子的价格（单位为布勒）。

Bulmart 管理层最近的想法是开发一个程序，帮助顾客以尽可能快的速度、在可承受的预算内获得铲子。严格来说，该程序需要找出：将 $*r*_{*j*}$ 把铲子运送到位于城市 $*g*_{*j*}$ 的顾客处，且总花费不超过 $*a*_{*j*}$ 布勒所需的最短时间。任意两个相邻城市之间的运输时间为 $1$。如果铲子从多个城市运送而来，运输时间等于最后一批货物到达的时间。运输本身不收取费用。

程序需要回答 $*q*$ 个询问。每个询问都需要独立处理，即一个询问不会改变后续询问中商店的铲子数量。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5000$，$0 ≤ *m* ≤ *min*(5000, *n*·(*n* - 1) / 2)$）。接下来的 $*m*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*x*_{*e*}$ 和 $*y*_{*e*}$，表示第 $*e*$ 条道路连接城市 $*x*_{*e*}$ 和 $*y*_{*e*}$（$1 ≤ *x*_{*e*}, *y*_{*e*} ≤ *n*$）。

下一行包含一个整数 $*w*$（$1 ≤ *w* ≤ 5000$）——Berland 中 Bulmart 商店的总数。接下来的 $*w*$ 行中，每行包含三个整数，描述第 $*i*$ 家商店：$*c*_{*i*}$、$*k*_{*i*}$、$*p*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$1 ≤ *k*_{*i*}, *p*_{*i*} ≤ 2·10^{5}$）。

下一行包含一个整数 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 1000$）——询问数量。接下来的 $*q*$ 行中，每行包含三个整数，描述第 $*j*$ 个询问：$*g*_{*j*}$、$*r*_{*j*}$ 和 $*a*_{*j*}$（$1 ≤ *g*_{*j*} ≤ *n*$，$1 ≤ *r*_{*j*}, *a*_{*j*} ≤ 10^{9}$）。

## 输出格式

输出 $*q*$ 行。第 $*j*$ 行输出第 $*j*$ 个询问的答案，即在总花费不超过 $*a*_{*j*}$ 布勒的情况下，将 $*r*_{*j*}$ 把铲子运送到城市 $*g*_{*j*}$ 的顾客处所需的最短时间。如果第 $*j*$ 个询问无解，输出 `-1`。
